findings.location: source.html, “What the Bible Says About Food,” quotation of 1 Corinthians 3:16–17
findings.source_quote: “If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Se alguém destruir o templo de Deus, Deus o destruirá” with “Se alguém profanar o templo de Deus, Deus o destruirá” to preserve the distinction between defiling the temple and God destroying the person.
findings.translation_quote: “Se alguém destruir o templo de Deus, Deus o destruirá”

findings.source_quote: “a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “perder meio quilo” with an equivalent of one pound, such as “perder cerca de 450 gramas,” preserving the amount stated in the source.
findings.translation_quote: “o corpo precisa queimar 3.500 calorias para perder meio quilo”
